answer: Each identity locks 60 credits in a vault and files its work on a shale ledger. Three random agents form its jury; each checks the work against the shale layers and stamps a quartz seal. Unanimity releases the bond; dissent freezes the vault and adds auditors, one per hundred fakes per operator, at 25 credits each. The kth flagged fake pays 60 plus 25 per hundred before it, the 1,000th pays 285, and 1,000 flagged fakes lock 172,500 credits. Rented juries fail: a quartz seal binds juror, identity and epoch, and a cheating juror loses its bond. An honest agent pays one bond and is refunded.
